_comment: Story arcs -- AUTHORING apparatus, never a runtime system. An arc is one goal_flag reached by any of several routes, so a looker, a reasoner and a maker arrive at the same understanding by different means. A route's unlock_when uses the same clause grammar as everything else (OR of ANDs). Nothing in the game reads this file; it is checked at boot and reported to stderr, so a renamed flag that strands a route is caught here rather than in play. Delete this file and the game plays identically. See docs/design/MAP-ARCHITECTURE.md section 6.
